parameters.specification/query:
DEFINE
	VAR __DS0FilterTable = 
		FILTER(
			KEEPFILTERS(VALUES('Device Set Assets Netbook'[Scheduled Ship Date])),
			AND(
				AND(
					'Device Set Assets Netbook'[Scheduled Ship Date] >= DATE(2025, 6, 1),
					'Device Set Assets Netbook'[Scheduled Ship Date] < DATE(2025, 7, 1)
				),
				'Device Set Assets Netbook'[Scheduled Ship Date] >= DATE(2025, 1, 1)
			)
		)

	VAR __DS0Core = 
		CALCULATETABLE(
			SUMMARIZE(
				'Device Set Assets Netbook',
				'Device Set Assets Netbook'[Order Number],
				'Device Set Assets Netbook'[Purchase Order Number],
				'Device Set Assets Netbook'[PO Date],
				'Device Set Assets Netbook'[First Booked Date],
				'Device Set Assets Netbook'[Account Name],
				'Device Set Assets Netbook'[Line Item Status],
				'Device Set Assets Netbook'[Part Number],
				'Device Set Assets Netbook'[Requested Quantity],
				'Device Set Assets Netbook'[Line Amount (Gbl Currency - USD)],
				'Device Set Assets Netbook'[Currency Code],
				'Device Set Assets Netbook'[Scheduled Ship Date],
				'Device Set Assets Netbook'[Zebra Customer Request Date]
			),
			KEEPFILTERS(__DS0FilterTable)
		)

EVALUATE
	__DS0Core

ORDER BY
	'Device Set Assets Netbook'[Order Number],
	'Device Set Assets Netbook'[Purchase Order Number],
	'Device Set Assets Netbook'[PO Date],
	'Device Set Assets Netbook'[First Booked Date],
	'Device Set Assets Netbook'[Account Name],
	'Device Set Assets Netbook'[Line Item Status],
	'Device Set Assets Netbook'[Part Number],
	'Device Set Assets Netbook'[Requested Quantity],
	'Device Set Assets Netbook'[Line Amount (Gbl Currency - USD)],
	'Device Set Assets Netbook'[Currency Code],
	'Device Set Assets Netbook'[Scheduled Ship Date],
	'Device Set Assets Netbook'[Zebra Customer Request Date]
